target: Convex Booster.earmarkRewards(pid) caller incentive (0.5% of claimed CRV): scheduled weekly earmark lumps + continuous earmarks; Aura Booster/BoosterLite same class
why: Daily breadth class (keeper/poke reward that the protocol pays to anyone; non-liquidation). Before this run the KB had no earmark row: the Convex rows 98/99 covered the Mower harvest and revenue distribution, not the Booster earmark. Measured 2026-11-12 run ce71d6eb: earmarkIncentive=50 bps (Convex 0xF403C135..., Aura eth/arb 50, base 10). 7d census of the Convex CRV outflow (blocks 26346800-26397200, 8865 Transfer logs, 905 txs): ~163k CRV/day earmarked, ~800 CRV/day to callers (~190 USD/day at Chainlink CRV 0.2374). WHO EARNS: lump winners 0x836c7c02 (EOA 0xfed97596), 0xdb2e12a8 (EOA 0xddc6e9aa), 0x37df2101 (EOA 0xb044294b), 0xd7de1056 (EOA 0xc06393bf), 0x02202b28, 0xabdcac13 (EOA 0x18ce06d5), 0x869ccb57, 0x55d8586b, 0x65e01305, 0x96e0b3b6 (about 10 searchers); continuous earmarks: 0xabdcac13 (535 tx) and 0xec58746c (287 tx). ECONOMICS: 47 lumps/7d = 5037 CRV (~1200 USD), gated by a stash reward hook that reverts crvChange until crvRewards.periodFinish+3600 s; 40/47 landed at exactly +3600/+3612 s at tx index 0-1, and 3/3 traced winners paid 99.7-99.9% of the CRV->ETH proceeds to block.coinbase (tx 0x02d8b635: 0.07105 ETH to builder, 0.0000448 kept). Continuous earmarks pay 0.26-0.9 CRV (0.06-0.21 USD) against 0.06-0.20 USD of gas (0.7-1.3M gas at 0.04-0.07 gwei). Aura: isShutdown()=true on eth/arb/base. Wiki infra/convex-earmark-builder-auction.md.
